notes.title: Update v1.07
notes.content:
Changes:
- Fixed a bug where two walls in the Upstairs / Living Room area would become dark and flicker when a certain intruder spawned.
- Added a "Special Thanks" section to the Credits screen.
- Adjusted spawn rate for certain festivities.
- Adjusted overall festivity spawning times.
- Made the balcony floor visibly different from the kitchen floor.

notes.title: Update v1.06c
notes.content:
Changes:
- Fixed a bug where reported festivities could complete during the pause screen.
- Added letterbox workaround so the game works with ultrawide monitors.
- Very slightly reduced the pace at which festivities are spawned.
